views.text: In February 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said a bottom-up review of AutoZone's product mix found 100% EV fleet could cut revenues 20 to 40% as motor oil and ignition parts vanish, though heavier EVs lift brake, chassis and suspension demand, with wheel motors ~$1,500.
